name: Pollution
description: Create: Smog tracks air pollution per chunk.

pages.title: Pollution
pages.text: Create: Smog tracks air pollution per chunk. Anything that burns adds smog to the chunk it stands in. It spreads to neighbours, fades slowly, and fades faster in rain. Trees, logs, water and plants absorb it.

pages.title: Why it exists
pages.text:
It is pressure, not a wall. A few furnaces barely register; a big industrial base left alone gets bad. The fix is built from Create parts, so cleaning is part of the machine room.\
\
[#](2E5AAC)[Control it](entry://survival/pollution_control)[#]().

pages.title: What pollutes
pages.text:
Every source adds smog per second:
- Campfire 1
- Stove (Farmer's Delight) 2
- Furnace, smoker 4
- Blast furnace 8
- Blaze Burner 16, superheated 32
- Blaze Burner with Straw, the same

pages.title: Blaze Burner
pages.text: The Create heat source pollutes while it burns fuel, so it is a common source in factories. One with no fuel is clean. See [#](2E5AAC)[Heat](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]().

pages.title: Other machines
pages.text: Any other machine that reports a "lit" state adds 3 per second. TFMG machines pollute only while burning fuel: engines 6 per block at full throttle (large 4), fireboxes 8, blast furnaces 30. Idle ones are clean. An Aerometer shows the real result.

pages.title: Aerometer
pages.text: Hold it to read the air where you stand. The levels are Clean, Light Haze, Polluted, Heavily Polluted and Toxic.

pages.title: Levels
pages.text: Levels by chunk value: Light Haze 400, Polluted 1,800, Heavily Polluted 4,500, Toxic 8,000. The cap is 10,000.

pages.title: What it does
pages.text: Heavy pollution gives you Nausea. Toxic adds Poison and Weakness. Land suffers too: crops lose growth, flowers and grass die, grass turns to dirt, and in toxic air farmland does too.
